frontmatter.description: Flutter widget correctness reviewer for screens, widgets, theme and routes. Use for UI code changes; not for visual/UX policy (ux-auditor) or non-widget logic (bug-hunter).

frontmatter.name: api-compat-auditor
frontmatter.description: Contract-compatibility reviewer for Dart↔Kotlin channels, Dart↔Rust bindings, DB schema, backup/settings formats and persisted preference keys. Use when a contract or persisted format changes.

frontmatter.name: bug-hunter
frontmatter.description: Logic-defect reviewer for Dart services, providers, controllers, models and utils (non-widget code). Use for general business-logic changes; not for widgets, Rust, Kotlin, schema or pure performance work.

frontmatter.name: concurrency-auditor
frontmatter.description: Concurrency and lifecycle reviewer for playback, async Dart, isolates, Kotlin threads and native callbacks. Use when shared state, streams, timers, isolates or threads change.

frontmatter.name: data-integrity-auditor
frontmatter.description: Data-integrity reviewer for the library scanner, metadata/tag/lyrics/cover/CUE/ReplayGain editing, SQLite databases, backups and collections. Use when data on disk or in the DB can change.

frontmatter.name: dead-code-hunter
frontmatter.description: Dead-code reviewer for unused files, symbols, l10n keys, assets, preference keys and native methods left by the offline migration. Run in scheduled cleanup or full audits, not on every commit.

frontmatter.name: dependency-auditor
frontmatter.description: Dependency and build reviewer for pubspec, Cargo, Gradle, toolchain pins and vendored packages. Use when dependencies, versions or build configuration change.

frontmatter.name: docs-auditor
frontmatter.description: Lightweight documentation and translation checker: AGENTS.md/plan/README consistency with the change, l10n key parity across arb files. Use for docs-only or translation-heavy commits.

frontmatter.name: review-fixer
frontmatter.description: Implements a batch of 1–3 related, validated review findings with tests. Use only after findings are VALIDATED in reviews/FINDINGS.md; never for discovery or review.
